answer.rationale: The scenario describes a near-miss with catastrophic release potential but no injury. Under 1910.119(m)(1), PSM requires investigation of any incident that could reasonably have resulted in a catastrophic release, regardless of injury. Recordkeeping reporting triggers (1904.39) require death or hospitalization/amputation/eye loss, none of which occurred here, so those do not apply. The facts given are sufficient to determine the PSM incident investigation requirement applies.
